whatIsSection.title: Dubai's Smartest Business Gateway
paragraphs: DUQE officially stands for Dubai Queen Elizabeth 2 Free Zone — a government-managed business ecosystem working under the Dubai Free Zone authority. DUQE is different from traditional free zones as it provides an all-digital platform for entrepreneurs to start and manage their companies from anywhere in the world.

Located on the iconic QE2 cruise ship at Port Rashid, DUQE Free Zone offers prestigious and flexible business services to individuals, freelancer businesses, SMEs, and large enterprises — with premium address recognition and competitiveness.
This exceptional location merges heritage with innovation, offering a fully digital, paperless, and easily set-up process that speaks to the modern entrepreneur.

setupStepsSection.title: Step-by-Step DUQE Company Setup Process
setupStepsSection.subtitle: Six simple steps to launch your business on the iconic QE2.

steps.title: Choose Business Activity
steps.description: Select one or multiple activities from DUQE's approved list — consulting, trading, media, and digital services are common.

steps.title: Select Legal Structure
steps.description: Choose FZE (sole founder), FZCO (multiple shareholders), or Branch Office of an existing UAE or foreign entity.

steps.title: Choose Your Trade Name
steps.description: Adhere to UAE naming guidelines — no offensive, religious, or political references. Must be available in DUQE's registry.

steps.title: Submit Documents
steps.description: Passport copy, digital photo, UAE residence visa (if applicable), completed application form, and business plan (if required).

steps.title: Receive Your Business License
steps.description: Choose from Commercial License, Consultancy License, Media & Freelance License, or General Trading License.

steps.title: Apply for Visas & Bank Account
steps.description: Apply for investor, employee, and partner visas. Set up a corporate bank account with a UAE-based or international bank.

items.q: What is DUQE Free Zone full form?
items.a: DUQE stands for Dubai Queen Elizabeth 2 Free Zone — located on the QE2 ship in Dubai. It is a government-managed business ecosystem working under the Dubai Free Zone authority.

items.q: What does a free zone mean in the UAE?
items.a: A free zone in the UAE is a designated area where businesses enjoy special benefits such as 100% foreign ownership, tax exemptions, and streamlined regulations to encourage international trade and investment.

items.q: Is DUQE a financial free zone?
items.a: No. DUQE is a general-purpose free zone focused on digital-first entrepreneurs, freelancers, SMEs, and global companies — not specifically a financial free zone like DIFC or ADGM.

items.q: How does DUQE compare to IFZA or RAKEZ?
items.a: DUQE is newer and more digital-focused than IFZA and RAKEZ. Its unique selling point is the iconic QE2 location at Port Rashid, fully paperless setup, and remote registration from anywhere in the world.

items.q: What kind of jobs are available in DUQE Free Zone?
items.a: DUQE supports consulting, IT services, e-commerce, marketing and advertising, freelancing, software and SaaS development, general trading, and education/professional training.

Yes. DUQE Free Zone is one of the newest free zones in Dubai, established on the iconic QE2 ship at Port Rashid. It merges heritage with innovation and offers a fully digital, paperless setup process.

items.q: What licenses are available in DUQE Free Zone?
items.a: DUQE offers Commercial License, Consultancy License, Media & Freelance License, and General Trading License — each tailored to specific business functions.

items.q: Can I register my DUQE company remotely?
items.a: Yes. DUQE is designed for remote business owners — everything from documentation to approvals to payments can be completed online from anywhere in the world.

items.q: What legal structures are available in DUQE?
items.a: You can set up a Free Zone Establishment (FZE) for sole founders, a Free Zone Company (FZCO) for multiple shareholders, or a Branch Office of an existing UAE or foreign entity.
